welcome.subject: Welcome to OutMass — your first campaign in 3 steps
welcome.heading: Welcome to OutMass 👋
welcome.intro: Thanks for signing in to OutMass! You're set up to send personalized mail-merge campaigns straight from your own Outlook account.
welcome.step1: Open **Outlook on the web** and click the round **OM button** in the bottom-right corner — it opens the OutMass panel.
welcome.step2: In the panel, upload your recipients as a **CSV** (there's a template inside), write your email, and drop `{{firstName}}` anywhere to personalize each message.
welcome.step3: Click **Preview** or send yourself a **Test Send**, then hit **Send**. OutMass paces delivery and tracks opens, clicks and replies.
welcome.free_plan: You start on the **Free plan** (${free_quota} emails/month) — you can upgrade anytime from the panel when you need more.
welcome.reply: Hit a snag or have a question? **Just reply to this email** — it comes straight to me and I usually answer within a few hours.
welcome.ps: P.S. The panel lives in Outlook **on the web** — in a browser tab, not the Windows/Mac desktop app. Whichever address your account uses is fine (outlook.office.com, outlook.live.com and outlook.cloud.microsoft all work). If you don't see the round button, refresh your Outlook tab once.
quota_capped.subject: ${skipped} recipients saved — they'll be sent automatically
quota_capped.heading: ${skipped} recipients saved 📬
quota_capped.saved: Your campaign just reached your monthly limit of **${limit} emails**. The remaining **${skipped} recipients are safely saved** — nothing was lost, and there's nothing you need to do.
quota_capped.sooner: Want them out sooner? Upgrading raises your limit immediately and the saved recipients go out on the next sending run — open the OutMass panel and click **Upgrade**.
quota_capped.questions: Questions? Just reply — it comes straight to me.
quota_capped.reset_on_date: on ${month} ${day}, when your monthly quota resets
upgrade.subject: Your OutMass ${plan_label} plan is active — thank you!
upgrade.heading: Your ${plan_label} plan is active 🎉
upgrade.intro: Thank you for upgrading — your **${plan_label}** plan is active as of now. What that means:
upgrade.point_quota: You can send up to **${quota} emails per month**.
upgrade.point_billing: Your billing month **starts today** and renews monthly from this date — your quota resets on the same day, not on the 1st.
upgrade.point_manage: See your usage anytime in the OutMass panel under **Account**, and manage or cancel via **Manage Subscription**.
upgrade.reply: If anything at all comes up — a question, a snag, a feature you're missing — **just reply to this email**. It comes straight to me.
upgrade.thanks: Thanks for backing a small product early. It means a lot.
plan_dropped.subject_payment_failed: Your OutMass plan has gone back to Free
plan_dropped.opening_payment_failed: Your subscription ended today. Stripe spent about two weeks trying the card on file, and you'll have had its emails about that.
plan_dropped.opening_promo_ended: The plan we set up for you has run its course, and your account is back on Free.
plan_dropped.free_quota: Free sends up to **${free_quota} emails a month**. Nothing was deleted — your campaigns, templates and contacts are exactly where you left them.
plan_dropped.carry_on_payment_failed: If you'd like to carry on, open the OutMass panel and pick a plan. A different card or payment method usually does it.
plan_dropped.carry_on_promo_ended: If you'd like to carry on, open the OutMass panel and pick a plan.
plan_dropped.questions: Questions, or something that didn't work? **Just reply** — it comes straight to me.
reauth.subject: Reconnect OutMass to Outlook
reauth.heading: Action needed: reconnect Outlook
reauth.expired: Your OutMass connection to Microsoft Outlook has expired. Until you reconnect, any scheduled campaigns and follow-ups will pause instead of sending.
reauth.how_to_fix: **How to fix it:** open the OutMass sidebar in Outlook Web, click the **Reconnect to Outlook** banner, and sign in again. Takes about 10 seconds.
reauth.reason: Reason: ${reason}. If you keep seeing this, reply to this email and we'll look into it.
account_deleted.subject: Your OutMass account has been deleted
account_deleted.heading: Your OutMass account has been deleted
account_deleted.removed: As you requested, your OutMass account and all associated data (campaigns, contacts, templates, Microsoft authorization, and settings) have been permanently removed.
account_deleted.audit_record: Per our Privacy Policy, we retain an anonymised audit record for 5 years to comply with fraud prevention and legal obligations. This record contains only a hash of your email address and aggregate counters — no content.
account_deleted.subscription: **If you had an active paid subscription**, it is managed separately through Stripe. If you need help cancelling or getting a refund, reply to this email.
inactivity_30d.subject: Still using OutMass?
inactivity_30d.heading: Still using OutMass?
inactivity_30d.noticed: We noticed you haven't used OutMass in about ${days} days. A heads-up rather than a nudge: your paid subscription is still active and still billed each month, whether or not you open it.
inactivity_30d.still_using: **If you still plan to use it**, there's nothing to do — open Outlook on the web and the OutMass panel is where you left it.
inactivity_30d.tell_us: **If something got in the way**, tell us what it was. Just reply to this email. That is genuinely the most useful thing you can send us, and a person reads every one.
inactivity_30d.stop_paying: **If you don't need it anymore**, you can stop paying today:
inactivity_30d.stop_panel: Open the OutMass panel → **Account** → **Manage Subscription**, or
inactivity_30d.stop_reply: Reply here, or write to [${support_email}](mailto:${support_email}) — we'll cancel it and refund the current period.
inactivity_30d.why_receiving: You're receiving this because you have an active paid OutMass subscription. This is a one-time note per inactive period.
inactivity_60d.subject: Still paying for OutMass without using it?
inactivity_60d.heading: Still paying for OutMass without using it?
inactivity_60d.noticed: You haven't logged into OutMass in around ${days} days. Your paid subscription has continued to renew during this time. We don't want you paying for something you're not getting value from.
inactivity_60d.way_keep: **Keep it** — open the OutMass panel in Outlook on the web, or reinstall it from the browser store you got it from. These emails stop as soon as you sign in.
inactivity_60d.way_tell: **Tell us what went wrong** — reply to this email. If something blocked you, we would much rather fix it than lose you.
inactivity_60d.way_cancel: **Cancel it** — reply to this email or contact [${support_email}](mailto:${support_email}) and we'll cancel the subscription plus refund the current billing period.
inactivity_60d.one_more: If we don't hear back, we'll reach out one more time at the 90-day mark before taking any further action.
inactivity_90d.subject: OutMass — a final check-in
inactivity_90d.heading: OutMass — a final check-in
inactivity_90d.noticed: It's been about ${days} days since you last used OutMass. We've written twice already, and we don't want to keep charging you for something you aren't using.
inactivity_90d.to_stop: **To stop paying**, reply to this email or write to [${support_email}](mailto:${support_email}) — we'll cancel the subscription and refund the current period, prorated.
inactivity_90d.what_stopped: **If something stopped you from using it**, we'd still like to know what. One line in a reply is enough, and it is worth more to us than the subscription.
inactivity_90d.not_yet: **If you just haven't got to it yet**, open the OutMass panel in Outlook on the web and these emails stop on their own.
inactivity_90d.last_one: This is the last automatic email we'll send about this. Your subscription stays exactly as it is unless you tell us otherwise.
